description:
A Flutter LLM Chat Client. Support Android & iOS & Harmony Next.

A Flutter LLM Chat Client. Support Android & iOS & Harmony Next.
✨ Features
- 🎨 Modern Design - Material You design language with dynamic color theming support (Android 12+).
- 🌙 Dark Mode - Perfectly adapted dark theme to protect your eyes.
- 🌍 Multi-language Support - Supports both English and Chinese interfaces.
- 🖥️ Multi-platform Support - Mobile (Android/iOS/Harmony) and Desktop (Windows/macOS/Linux).
- 🔄 Multi-provider Support - Supports major AI providers like OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic, etc.
- 🤖 Custom Assistants - Create and manage personalized AI assistants.
- 🖼️ Multimodal Input - Supports various formats including images, text documents, PDFs, Word documents, etc.
- 📝 Markdown Rendering - Full support for code highlighting, LaTeX formulas, tables, and more.
- 🎙️ Voice/TTS Providers - Built-in system TTS plus OpenAI / Google Gemini / ElevenLabs voice servers.
- 🛠️ MCP Support - Model Context Protocol tool integration.
- 🧰 Built-in MCP Tools - Includes a built-in MCP Fetch tool.
- 🔍 Web Search - Integrated with multiple search engines (Exa, Tavily, Zhipu, LinkUp, Brave, Bing, Metaso, SearXNG, Ollama, Jina, Perplexity, Bocha).
- 🧩 Prompt Variables - Supports dynamic variables like model name, time, etc.
- 📤 QR Code Sharing - Export and import provider configurations via QR codes.
- 💾 Data Backup - Supports chat history backup and restoration.
- 🌐 Custom Requests - Supports custom HTTP request headers and bodies.
- 🔡 Custom Fonts - Bring your own fonts (system fonts / Google Fonts).
- ⚙️ Android Background Generation - Keep chat generation running in the background (optional setting).
What's Changed
- feat: Add workspaces with desktop terminals, Android and iOS sandboxes, skills, and mobile MCP stdio.
- feat: Add scheduled assistant tasks on Android, desktop, and iOS.
- feat: Add mobile background execution with notifications, overlays, and Live Activities.
- feat: Add ChatGPT, Grok, and Kimi Code OAuth login, with mobile browser sign-in and cache TTL settings.
- feat: Add Accessibility phone control on Android.
- feat: Add Kimi Basic, Kimi Pro, and Kagi search providers.
- feat: Add settings search.
- feat: Add sticky, cooldown, and delay effects for world books, plus per-conversation prompts.
- feat: Add reordering for TTS and speech recognition services.
- feat: Preview SVG code blocks inline.
- feat: Collapse long user messages behind an expand toggle.
- feat: Restore Google Fonts with on-demand downloads.
- feat: Add assistant gradient backgrounds.
- feat: Show the context message count in the context management sheet.
- feat: Restore backup snapshots from startup recovery.
- feat: Add an optional ISO 8601 format for appended message time.
- feat: Add an option to hide the system title bar on Linux.
- feat: Adapt DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, MiMo v2.6 vision, and Grok 4.7 reasoning.
- fix: Bundle the MSVC runtime so Windows can launch without a separate Visual C++ install.
- fix: Restore the Windows window position after display changes, and fix clipboard history paste.
- fix: Fix Gemini tool follow-ups by dropping unsigned empty text and keeping the text thought signature.
- fix: Keep hosted search cards inline, and migrate Grok built-in search to Responses tools.
- fix: Render inline thinking next to tool calls, and keep reasoning state when creating a conversation.
- fix: Honor the Qwen Audio capture sample rate, and ignore premature empty Google STOP frames.
- fix: Paginate memory_read, send custom provider headers when listing models, and stop the default SiliconFlow balance lookup.
- fix: Improve Android high refresh rate compatibility.
- fix: Honor the chat background mask strength on tablets.
- fix: Speed up streaming and long-message Markdown rendering.
- fix: Fix several other known bugs and UI issues.
Full Changelog: https://github.com/Chevey339/kelivo/compare/v1.2.6...v1.3.0
